#version 460
#extension GL_NV_cooperative_vector : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_float16 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_16bit_storage : require
layout(local_size_x=1) in; float16_t data[16];
void main() { coopvecNV<float16_t,4> a=coopvecNV<float16_t,4>(float16_t(1)); coopVecReduceSumAccumulateNV(a,data,0u); }
